rootCauses.summary: web/main.js::boot constructs the full generated hunt village before exposing the title, and NightView.build creates all NPC actors plus hunt-scale decoration even though the title has its own poster/video surface.
rootCauses.prediction: A title-only preview budget removes full NPC/decor construction from the pre-input path while the first real hunt still uses the unchanged full build.
rootCauses.falsifier: The title path still creates all NPCs/hunt detail, the real hunt receives preview density, or the immutable After TAP/long-task evidence does not improve.

observation.summary: Immutable staging at a4baa32 confirms version identity and shows TAP taking 9410ms, with an 8157ms main-thread long task beginning at the pointer event. Title snapshot remains mode=title, fps=4, 207 draw calls and 65,879 triangles. This is new evidence beyond the earlier brand scheduling experiment.

conditions.scenario: cold open -> TAP -> title; attempted review enter

notVerified: which individual Three.js allocation dominates the 8.157s task

evidence.statement: clickText TAP took 9410ms; a long task starting at the pointer event lasted 8157ms; title snapshot reported fps 4, 207 draw calls, 65,879 triangles.
Before title handoff, boot creates a preview RaidSession and calls view.build(game.village), the same full world builder used by real hunts.
The build path creates hunt-scale architecture, decoration, all NPC actors and actor batches without a title-preview mode.

hypothesis.cause: Full hunt-world construction sits on the title readiness path even though the title has an independent cinematic/poster presentation.
hypothesis.prediction: Use a bounded title preview world, omit NPC actor creation while title-only, and keep the real hunt full build unchanged; TAP readiness and the extreme long-task tail should improve without gameplay changes.
hypothesis.falsifier: Native assertions cannot prove full hunt density is preserved, or same-condition immutable After retains an equivalent ~8s pointer-blocking task.

candidates.reason: Moves only non-gameplay title presentation cost off the readiness path and preserves the full world when the hunt starts.
Would extend iteration 2 by inertia and reduce the real hunt world rather than isolating title-only cost.

implementation.summary: Add a title-only world detail budget, omit title-only NPC actor construction, and retain the existing full build for every actual hunt.

limitations: Portable balance probe is coverage-out because this is rendering/bootstrap presentation cost.
Hosted Chromium timing is directional and not a physical-device benchmark.

retryJustification: Earlier startup scheduling work said not to continue without new evidence. The current immutable version supplies new evidence: TAP is blocked for 9.4s with an 8.157s pointer-adjacent long task, and source now identifies full title-world construction as a distinct root cause.
